description: Reported bug: when the Counter-Offensive interrupt was offered, the dialog listed an ATTACHED CHARACTER as a unit of its own — the Blade Champion leading Custodian Guard got its own 'Fight Next (2 CP)' row alongside the Guard's. 11e 19.01: 'an attached unit is a single unit for all rules purposes', so the Attached unit gets ONE row. The old builder (StratagemManager.get_counter_offensive_eligible_units) walked raw unit dicts and applied the retired 10e target condition ('within Engagement Range … not already selected to fight'), so any attached character standing in the melee — as in the report — got listed twice over. It now folds each Attached unit onto its bodyguard and takes 15.12's real target condition ('one friendly unit that is eligible to fight', 12.04) from the live FightSequencer. Player path: P2 (Orks, active) passes both Pile In halves, selects the Warboss engaged with the Custodian Guard, assigns all attacks and resolves them; the Counter-Offensive window then opens for P1 and must show the Attached unit as ONE row named 'Custodian Guard + Blade Champion' with no Blade Champion row of its own (the Telemon Heavy Dreadnought, separately engaged with the same Warboss, is a unit in its own right and keeps its row — the fold must not collapse unrelated units). Clicking that row spends 2 CP and hands P1 the activation for the whole Attached unit. Setup-only privileges: P2's CP is zeroed so no Ork stratagem prompt (e.g. Epic Challenge on the Warboss) interleaves with the window under test; Custodes model wounds are inflated so nobody dies mid-scenario; the dialog's 5-second auto-decline timer is stopped once the dialog is up so the assertions and screenshot are not racing it (the auto-decline itself is not what this scenario covers).
